svg.data-weight-note: 6.3 lb (2.9 kg), Table 26; 2.89 kg in the datasheet
svg.data-depth-note: 8.43 in (21.40 cm), Table 17; 8.42 in in the datasheet
svg.data-power-input: 100 to 240 VAC at 1.5 A, 50 to 60 Hz (Table 34)
svg.data-cooling: one inbuilt fan, front-to-back airflow, 9 CFM (datasheet)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 50 C at sea level, 0 to 45 C up to 1500 m, 0 to 40 C up to 3000 m
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 6 EX4000 switches; the two Virtual Chassis ports are SFP+ and VC formation is not supported with a 10GBASE-T transceiver in them
svg.data-uplink-ports: two SFP+ ports take 1 GbE or 10 GbE transceivers
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the two Virtual Chassis ports and the two uplink ports are 1GE or 10GE SFP+ ports (Table 17 and Figure 11 callout 8). Virtual Chassis is supported only with 10GE SFP+, and not with a 10GBASE-T transceiver in a Virtual Chassis port
svg.data-oob: management Ethernet RJ-45 on the rear panel, with a link activity lamp and a status lamp
svg.data-console: RJ-45 console on the rear panel, labelled CON
svg.data-usb: one USB 2.0 Type-A port on the front panel
svg.data-acoustic: 23.1 dBA (guide Table 4, no PoE load applies)
